validated_results.title: Proteomic Analysis of Sphingolipid Metabolic Enzymes with Risk of Bladder Cancer Incidence and Mortality in the Atherosclerosis Risk in Communities Study.
validated_results.reason: The measured exposures are plasma sphingolipid metabolic enzyme proteins (e.g., SPHK1), with ceramides mentioned only incidentally as a lipid class function, so no ceramide exposure estimate for bladder cancer incidence exists.

validated_results.title: Iron-catalyzed oxidative stress reveals an exposome-related ferroptosis-resistant karyomegalic niche in BRCA1-linked renal carcinogenesis.
validated_results.reason: Iron-driven renal carcinogenesis was studied experimentally in Brca1 mutant rats with tissue/molecular and TCGA tumor analyses, not in a human population exposure-incidence design.
